en-US.title: LofiBuddha
en-US.subtitle: Meditation, Lofi & Breathwork
en-US.description:
LofiBuddha is your personal sanctuary for mindfulness. Discover a unique blend of lofi music, AI-guided meditations, breathwork exercises, and immersive soundscapes — all designed to help you focus, find calm, and sleep deeply.

◆ LOFI MUSIC FOR FOCUS
Curated lo-fi soundtracks crafted for deep work, study sessions, and creative flow. Layer ambient soundscapes on top for your perfect atmosphere.

◆ GUIDED MEDITATIONS
AI-powered meditation sessions for every mood — from morning energy to evening wind-down. Choose from focus, breathe, sleep, and relax journeys.

◆ BREATHWORK
Science-backed breathing exercises to reduce stress, boost energy, or prepare for restful sleep.

◆ IMMERSIVE WORLDS
Step inside beautifully designed sonic environments — temple gardens, ocean shores, mountain retreats — and stay a while.

◆ DAILY AFFIRMATIONS
Start each day with a personalised affirmation to set your intention.

◆ WORKSHOPS & COURSES
Multi-day guided journeys to deepen your practice over time.

◆ BUDDHA AI
Your mindful AI companion — ask questions, get guidance, or simply reflect.

Whether you're studying, working, meditating, or winding down for the night, LofiBuddha is your companion for mindful living.

Subscription options available. Free tier includes daily practices and core soundscapes.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://lofibuddha.com/legal/terms
Privacy Policy: https://lofibuddha.com/legal/privacy

fr-FR.title: LofiBuddha
fr-FR.subtitle: Méditation, lofi, respiration
fr-FR.description:
LofiBuddha est ton refuge pour la pleine conscience. Un mélange de musique lofi, de méditations guidées, d'exercices de respiration et de paysages sonores — pour te concentrer, t'apaiser et dormir profondément.

◆ MUSIQUE LOFI POUR LE FOCUS
Des bandes-son lo-fi choisies pour le travail profond, les révisions et le flow créatif. Ajoute des nappes ambient jusqu'à trouver la bonne atmosphère.

◆ MÉDITATIONS GUIDÉES
Des séances pour chaque humeur — de l'énergie du matin au soir. Choisis focus, souffle, sommeil ou détente.

◆ RESPIRATION
Des exercices de souffle pour réduire le stress, relancer l'énergie ou préparer un sommeil calme.

◆ MONDES SONORES
Entre dans des lieux sonores dessinés — jardins de temple, rivages, retraites en montagne — et reste un moment.

◆ AFFIRMATIONS DU JOUR
Commence la journée par une phrase personnelle qui pose ton intention.

◆ ATELIERS ET PARCOURS
Des voyages guidés sur plusieurs jours pour approfondir ta pratique.

◆ BUDDHA AI
Ton compagnon attentif — pose une question, demande un repère, ou réfléchis simplement.

Que tu étudies, travailles, médites ou fermes la journée, LofiBuddha t'accompagne.

Des abonnements sont proposés. L'offre gratuite comprend les pratiques du jour et les paysages sonores essentiels.

it.title: LofiBuddha
it.subtitle: Meditazione, lofi e respiro
it.description:
LofiBuddha è il tuo rifugio per la consapevolezza. Musica lofi, meditazioni guidate, esercizi di respiro e paesaggi sonori — per concentrarti, calmarti e dormire profondamente.

◆ MUSICA LOFI PER IL FOCUS
Colonne sonore lo-fi scelte per il lavoro profondo, lo studio e il flow creativo. Aggiungi paesaggi ambient finché l'atmosfera è giusta.

◆ MEDITAZIONI GUIDATE
Sessioni per ogni stato d'animo — dall'energia del mattino alla sera. Scegli focus, respiro, sonno o relax.

◆ RESPIRO
Esercizi di respirazione per abbassare lo stress, ridare energia o preparare un sonno tranquillo.

◆ MONDI SONORI
Entra in ambienti sonori disegnati — giardini di templi, rive del mare, ritiri in montagna — e resta un po'.

◆ AFFERMAZIONI DEL GIORNO
Inizia la giornata con una frase personale che fissa la tua intenzione.

◆ WORKSHOP E PERCORSI
Viaggi guidati di più giorni per approfondire la pratica nel tempo.

◆ BUDDHA AI
Il tuo compagno presente — fai una domanda, chiedi un orientamento o semplicemente rifletti.

Che tu studi, lavori, mediti o chiuda la giornata, LofiBuddha ti accompagna.

Sono disponibili abbonamenti. Il piano gratuito include le pratiche quotidiane e i paesaggi sonori essenziali.

apple.reviewNotes:
Thank you for reviewing LofiBuddha.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
• mindful_monthly (€1.99) — Mindful tier
• enlightened_monthly (€4.99) — Enlightened tier
Both are auto-renewing monthly subscriptions in group “LofiBuddha Premium”, purchased via StoreKit / RevenueCat.

HOW TO TEST FREE FEATURES
1. Open the app → Today tab
2. Play a free meditation or soundtrack from Explore / Library
3. Open Buddha AI and send a short message

HOW TO TEST SUBSCRIPTIONS (Sandbox)
Use a Sandbox Apple ID. Tap Bodhi Pro / Deepen → choose Mindful or Enlightened → complete the StoreKit purchase sheet.

ACCOUNT
Email/password or Google sign-in is optional for browsing free content. Sign-in is required before web Stripe checkout; on iOS, StoreKit handles purchase and can restore via Account → Restore.
